newsitem.title: CHINA: China service sector is 38.1 pct of GDP in Q1 1997.
newsitem.headline: China service sector is 38.1 pct of GDP in Q1 1997.

text.p: China's service sector accounted for 38.1 percent of gross domestic product (GDP) in the first quarter of this year, up by 1.2 percentage points from the same period of 1996, state media said on Wednesday.
It was the first time for several years that the proportion of the service industry in China's GDP had increased, the Xinhua Daily Telegraph said.
China's economy grew by 9.4 percent in the first quarter.
Primary industry accounted for 9.5 percent of GDP, down by 0.4 percentage points, while secondary industry accounted for 52.4 percent, down by 0.8 percentage points in the first quarter, it said.
China's GDP is forecast to grow 9.6 percent year-on-year in the first half of 1997 to 3.35 trillion yuan ($400 billion), state media has said.
The economy grew by 9.7 percent last year and officials have set a target of eight percent for 1997 to try to cool the economy before it show signs of overheating.
